description: Adds a stock line to an inventory item. Provide inventory item id, name, optional identifier (serial, lot code, or other label), quantity (default 1), and status (InStock, Ordered, Outbound, Damaged). Use quantity greater than 1 for fungible groups (e.g. 5 of the same lot). An item can track at most 500 stock lines. Returns the created line.
name: add_inventory_unit
